hypothesis: A direct listwise candidate-set Mamba ranker can select frozen Route-A K=50 candidates better than the frozen NVP-derived baselines under the same validation-only policy-45 protocol.

architecture.name: SetConditionedMambaRanker
architecture.candidate_encoder: shared program-conditioned Mamba over each ordered frozen candidate pass sequence
architecture.ranking_head: shared scalar linear score after candidate-set interaction

ranking_target.permutation: descending raw_candidate_value; candidate ID ascending deterministic tie break

objective.listwise_loss: ListMLE negative log likelihood of the frozen oracle permutation, mean-normalized over the 49 nonconstant ranking positions
objective.pairwise_loss: logistic pairwise ranking loss only for sampled pairs where raw_candidate_value_i > raw_candidate_value_j
objective.pair_sampling: uniform candidate pairs from the training seed's Torch RNG; no resampling based on outcome

training.lr_schedule: 500-step linear warmup then cosine to lr*0.01 over remaining 9500 steps
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: maximum ValidationFinalMeanOverOz policy-45 dataset macro mean; deterministic first checkpoint on exact tie

validation.ranking: descending scores; candidate ID ascending tie break
